name: Structure
description: One action for each tidy-up you'd do by hand: pull a passage into its own note, sort a list or a note's children.

actions.label: Extract to a child block
actions.description: Make the passage (or the list item and its children) a new child of the note, and put !((child)) where it was: one step, undone whole

actions.label: Sort the selected list
actions.description: Sort the list items the passage touches, with their sub-items, by title or a property they have

args.name: by
args.label: Sort by
args.description: title, or a property the items have

actions.label: Sort the list in this block
actions.description: Sort the block's first list (list=2: the second) by title or a property its items have

args.name: by
args.label: Sort by
args.description: title, or a property the items have

args.name: list
args.label: Which list
args.description: which list in the block, 1 the first

actions.label: Sort the children
actions.description: Sort the block's child blocks by title, by created, or by a property they have, in one step

args.name: by
args.label: Sort by
args.description: title, created, or a property the children have
